connector.name: Scholar Sidekick
connector.registryDescription: Catch AI-fabricated citations (real DOI + fake title). Retraction, open-access, 10,000+ CSL styles.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package scholar-sidekick-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mlava account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCHOLAR_API_KEY
env.description: Not required. Scholar Sidekick works fully anonymously with no key and no signup — leave this unset for normal use. Set it only to raise rate limits and enable the verifier's optional LLM screen. Free first-party ssk_ key from https://scholar-sidekick.com/account; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

env.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
env.description: Not required, and not the normal way to use this server — anonymous access is the default and needs no key at all. Only for customers on a paid RapidAPI plan; when set, calls route through the RapidAPI gateway instead of the direct API. https://rapidapi.com/scholar-sidekick-scholar-sidekick-api/api/scholar-sidekick
